intro: Scavenger Paws are severed limbs gathered from the young and ragged wolves roaming the hills of Deathknell. Newly awakened Forsaken collect them for local caretakers to stitch together into crude, protective gear.

p: Resources are scarce for the newly returned in Deathknell. With the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade pressing against Tirisfal, every scrap of hide and bone is put to practical use. Novice Elreth, assistant to Shadow Priest Sarvis, collects paws from the local scavenger wolves alongside bat wings to fashion serviceable garments and armor for disoriented Forsaken stepping fresh from their graves.
